max_output_tokens.description: Sizing hint; hard ceiling is 4 UTF-8 bytes/token.

aspects.description: all=everything; overview=compact except file_tree; omitted=languages/packages/entry_points; cycles is opt-in.

max_output_tokens.description: auto/outline sizing hint (default 2500), hard ceiling 4 UTF-8 bytes/token. Lines stay whole; explicit full is uncapped unless set.

source_mode.description: auto outlines 200+ line containers; full returns source; outline lists members.

mode.description: full: all+semantic; moderate: filtered+semantic; fast: filtered only; cross-repo-intelligence: link services.

name.description: Name override; Non-ASCII bytes are encoded; unsafe characters normalized.

diagnostics.description: Coverage rows: counts, five samples, or up to 500.

verbose.description: Add worktree/shadow Git paths for index-location debugging.

include_details.description: Alias for detail=stats: include branch, node/edge counts and database size. Slower.

metadata_only.description: Compatibility: omit counts, size, and branch.

mode.description: outline pages headings; get reads; update replaces the whole document; set_sections rewrites only the named sections and leaves every other byte untouched (an identical repeated write is byte-identical, so retrying is safe); sections is legacy.

section_updates.description: set_sections: section name -> new body. Any heading name works; names match exactly, including case.

cursor.description: Snapshot continuation; keep query/project/graph. Format, budget, and max_rows may change.

format.description: tree may use local @N+suffix prefix refs; json uses direct strings.

graph.description: code graph (default) or missed coverage-gap file tree.

max_output_tokens.description: Sizing hint; hard ceiling is 4 UTF-8 bytes/token. Rows stay whole.

max_rows.description: Visible rows (default 200; max 99998); 0 uses the legacy maximum. Evaluation is unchanged.

offset.description: Live compatibility paging; cannot be combined with cursor.

raw_content_offset.description: Raw-line byte offset; omit for match-centered preview.

cursor.description: Pass next/next_cursor with traversal args unchanged; budget may increase.

format.description: tree chooses smaller complete direct/grouped output; json uses stable grouped tables.

limit.description: Rows/page; gte flags the 5000-node engine ceiling.

max_output_tokens.description: Sizing hint; hard ceiling is 4 UTF-8 bytes/token. Evidence/args yield before nearest graph rows.

mode.description: calls, argument-aware data_flow, or service edges.

tool_descriptions.check_index_coverage: Best-effort exact-path/scope coverage and freshness, paged separately. full diagnostics adds raw detail. Clean is not proof of completeness.
tool_descriptions.compare_graphs: Compare two indexed snapshots: deterministic target-only additions and base-only removals of stable node/edge identities; each set capped by limit and a 512 KiB budget with exact totals and truncation reasons.
tool_descriptions.delete_project: Delete a project from the index
tool_descriptions.detect_changes: Map a Git diff to files and impact. Page with snapshot cursors.
tool_descriptions.get_architecture: Compact counts, languages, packages, entry points. Request structure, dependencies, routes, hotspots, boundaries, layers, clusters, cycles, or file_tree; path scopes a directory.
tool_descriptions.get_code_snippet: Read a search_graph symbol. auto bounds source and outlines large containers; full restores up to 500 lines. Source/outline pages continue; coverage_note marks gaps.
tool_descriptions.get_file_outline: Declaration outline of one exact repository-relative file: optional exact label filter, source order, exact total/offset/limit paging; file/folder/container nodes excluded.
tool_descriptions.get_graph_schema: Get node-label and edge-type counts. diagnostics=full also lists queryable properties.
tool_descriptions.index_repository: Index a repository. full/moderate add semantics; fast omits them; cross-repo-intelligence links services. Reports coverage gaps.
tool_descriptions.index_status: Project readiness, counts, root, and coverage gaps. diagnostics adds coverage rows; verbose adds Git paths. Best-effort only; verify cited paths with check_index_coverage.
tool_descriptions.ingest_traces: Validate and count traces; graph edge creation is not implemented
tool_descriptions.list_projects: List projects with stable paging. Identity is lean; stats adds graph sizes.
tool_descriptions.manage_adr: Outline an ADR by default; get reads it; update replaces it
tool_descriptions.query_graph: Read-only Cypher for multi-hop, aggregation, complexity, or cross-service analysis. Default: 200 visible rows with exact/lower-bound totals and truncation; continue safely with next_cursor. graph=missed is a file tree of flagged coverage gaps; absence is not proof of completeness. Use get_graph_schema(diagnostics=full) for properties.
tool_descriptions.read_file: Read one bounded UTF-8 file beneath an explicitly configured allowed-root capability. The native process rejects traversal, absolute paths, symlinks, sensitive names, non-regular files, and requests above the Phase 1 byte or line ceilings before content.
tool_descriptions.search_code: Graph-ranked text search: compact symbols, full bounded source, or file paths.
tool_descriptions.search_graph: Find symbols via BM25 query, regex name/qn filters, or semantic_query. Rows keep qn/file/lines and in/out over CALLS/USAGE/CALL_REFERENCE/INHERITS/IMPLEMENTS.
tool_descriptions.trace_path: Trace callers/callees, data flow, or cross-service paths. Defaults exclude tests and resolver evidence. Rows keep qn/hop with explicit totals, relations, and continuations.
